visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a dark blue t-shirt and denim shorts sits on a patterned brown carpet in a hotel room, holding a young toddler girl. The woman smiles brightly and points one finger upward towards the ceiling as the toddler looks curiously at the camera. In the background, two hotel beds with white linens and a baby crib are visible under soft indoor lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a wide-angle shot of a grand hotel lobby featuring a vaulted ceiling with dark wooden beams and large white hanging lanterns. Intricate tribal-patterned carpets cover the floor where a small child in pink clothing runs across the space. The setting is luxurious and spacious with numerous lounge chairs and decorative mezzanine levels. (3) A young boy wearing blue swimming goggles and a rash guard is seen splashing and swimming in a bright blue outdoor pool. The surrounding environment includes natural rock features and greenery under bright daylight. The camera then cuts back to the hotel lobby, focusing on the ornate upper architectural details and mezzanine railings. (4) A woman and two young boys dressed in matching black t-shirts walk through the hotel lobby's entrance. They then appear outdoors in a tropical garden setting with palm trees and a large stone building. The woman and the two boys jump into the air with their arms wide open, expressing excitement against a backdrop of vibrant green foliage and sunny skies. (5) A detailed graphic map titled "Explorers Lodge" is displayed on screen, highlighting various colored sections. Subsequently, children are seen pushing open a set of large, rustic wooden double doors with metal handles. They enter a sunlit outdoor patio area where palm trees and resort buildings are visible in the background under clear skies. (6) In a brightly lit indoor area with tropical-themed murals, Mickey Mouse, Minnie Mouse, and Goofy characters in safari-style outfits interact with the family. The characters wear khaki vests and hats, shaking hands and posing for photos with a woman and children. The background features decorative wood panels and artifact displays in glass cases. (7) A panoramic view shows a clean and modern hotel room with two beds. A Mickey Mouse silhouette is prominent on the headboard, and a staff member in a blue uniform is shown adjusting a blue bed rail. A baby stroller and suitcases are parked near the entrance, indicating a family stay in a well-equipped facility. (8) Two boys enter an indoor playroom called "Nemo's" with a seaside theme. The room contains a blue slide shaped like a boat, digital interactive walls with glowing circular buttons, and several large colorful foam blocks on a soft floor. A woman in a white shirt and denim shorts is seen playing with the toddler girl in the playroom. (9) A wooden sign for the "Trading Post" gift shop is shown, decorated with carved birds and hanging ornaments. Inside the shop, the camera pans over shelves stocked with Disney character plush toys, clothing, and various colorful souvenirs. The space is brightly lit with warm artificial lights and has a rustic, explorative atmosphere. (10) A boy drives a green pedal kart along a paved track in an outdoor garden area. The final scene returns to the hotel room where the woman, wearing the same blue t-shirt, makes a large heart gesture with her arms over her head while the toddler girl stands beside her, smiling at the camera.
